usedFor: CompanyCam holds job site projects and photos, Freshsales Classic holds deals, and “Project Updated” can drive “Update Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “Archived Project” in CompanyCam, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: Archiving a project is a clear end point, and the action can change a deal’s stage, amount or close date.

watchOut: “Update Deal” finds the deal by deal ID or name, so the CompanyCam event has to supply one of them.
